Template-Based Shape Processor with Downcasting & Cross Casting

Problem Statement:
You are required to design a shape processing system using:

Base class

Derived classes

Template function

dynamic_cast for downcasting and cross casting

🔹 Class Hierarchy
Shape   (Base class – polymorphic)
/   \
Circle   Rectangle

🔹 Requirements
1️⃣ Base Class
class Shape {
public:
virtual void display() = 0;
virtual ~Shape() {}
};

(Make it polymorphic using virtual function.)

2️⃣ Derived Classes

Circle

Data member: radius

Function: area()

Rectangle

Data members: length, width

Function: area()

3️⃣ Template Function

Create a function template:

template <typename T>
void processShape(Shape* ptr);

Inside the function:

Try downcasting:

T* derived = dynamic_cast<T*>(ptr);

If successful:

Print area

If failed:

Print:

Invalid cast

🔹 Input Format
type
values
cast_type

Where:

type → circle or rectangle

values:

circle → radius

rectangle → length width

cast_type → circle or rectangle

🔹 Output Rules

If cast succeeds:

Area: <value>

If cast fails:

Invalid cast
